rawFindings.title: _dispatch logs 'Processed' without processing duration
rawFindings.explanation: The processing duration logging using prettyHrtime was removed, so the log message no longer shows how long processing took for a file. This reduces visibility for performance monitoring.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore timing logic using process.hrtime and prettyHrtime to include processing time in log: capture start time before processing and log duration after processing.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When processing files, the debug log 'Processed: {path}' does not include the elapsed time, so timing info is lost.

rawFindings.title: _generate logs generator keys without elapsed time
rawFindings.explanation: The code removed timing calculations and now logs only the generator key string, omitting the time taken. This reduces detail in debug logs and may hinder performance analysis.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the timing calls (process.hrtime / prettyHrtime) and include elapsed time in the debug message.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When running generators during _generate(), logs miss the elapsed time durations, decreasing observability of generator performance.

rawFindings.title: _generate reduce always returns array or undefined incorrectly concatenating generators with no return
rawFindings.explanation: The original code returns `data ? result.concat(data) : result;` ensuring the reduce accumulates arrays correctly. The change returns `data ? result.concat(data) : data;` causing the reduce to possibly return undefined leading to type errors in subsequent processing steps when a generator returns no result.
rawFindings.suggestion: Use `return data ? result.concat(data) : result;` to ensure accumulation is an array and not undefined.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If a generator returns undefined, the Promise.reduce result is undefined instead of the accumulated array, causing failures downstream which expect an array of items to process.

rawFindings.title: _generate processes non-object items without path property causing error
rawFindings.explanation: The previous code processes any item with a defined path property. The change skips processing if the item is not an object or lacks a path property, preventing possible runtime errors when accessing properties on non-objects or undefined.
rawFindings.suggestion: No fix needed; this is an improvement that avoids errors on invalid items.

rawFindings.title: generateConsole logs 'Generated' without elapsed time
rawFindings.explanation: The change removed elapsed time logging for generated files, so log messages are less informative about how long generation took per file.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore elapsed time measurement around file generation and include it in the log message.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Logs show only 'Generated: {path}' without indicating generation time, reducing performance visibility.
